text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm back in form, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That should be enough to make up for
my
embarrassment at the exhibition
race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I may not look it, but I have
quite the
competitive streak.
choice_data_list: Were you worrying about it that much?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want to appear calm and collected in
the eyes of
the world, so I make an
effort not to let it show.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But when I'm with you... Well, there's no
harm in
letting one person see the real
me, is there?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. What race do you
think would
make the best stage for the
revived Emperor to
reinforce her
dominance?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A fine choice. Equal in prestige to the
Big Eight, it
holds the additional
distinction of serving as an
international
invitational.
choice_data_list: I want to aim for the 'Japan Cup'.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Its trophy will make a perfect jewel for
the
Emperor's crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then it's settled. The Japan Cup it is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way back from the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hear that there's an excellent teahouse
just
ahead. Do you know it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My subordinates in the student council
told me
that I had to go if I ever visited
Kyoto. What do
you say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that was a little unclear... I'm
asking if
you want to join me on a little
diversion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. Is it really such a shock?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes. I usually head straight to the
office after
races, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, the student council is as hectic as
ever, but
recently I have carved myself
out a little
breathing room.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is to say, I have revised our
workflow. I still
have final say on all
decisions, but I've stepped
back
somewhat from the direct labor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Instead, I have offloaded some
responsibility
onto the other members
and turned the process
into a more
collaborative effort.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In the past, I tried to do everything myself, for better and for worse.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But now, I guide the other members as
they strive
in their own ways to realize
our collective dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In many ways, it is more taxing than
before, both
mentally and physically.
Looking after them will
no doubt still
strain my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But I cannot bring about a world of bliss
on my
own. The world is built by
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Therefore, everyone has to do their part.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like leaning on others has
reduced
Symboli Rudolf's own burden.
She seems a lot less
stressed today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But that's enough about that. I'm itching
to try
this tea.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've heard it's tea-riffic! ...What do you
think?
Was that good?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You seem awfully prickly today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us pay a visit to the teahouse
and
enjoy a tea-riff... um, a delightful
time in each
other's company.
